FOUND_NOTHING: The team spent days walking along the beach, digging in the sand and checking the shallow tide pools. They found only broken shells and driftwood, returning to the capital empty-handed.
Scouts searched the coastal cliffs but found only jagged rocks and empty bird nests. There were no hidden caves or ancient ruins to be found.
The expedition explored a ruined lighthouse on the coast. Inside, they found only broken furniture and rusted tools, leaving with nothing of value.
The team patrolled the sandy shores, looking for shipwrecks or lost cargo. They found a few broken planks, but nothing worth bringing back.
While exploring a coastal cave, the team found it to be completely empty. The walls were bare, and there was no sign of treasure or danger.
The team mapped the local fishing villages, expecting to find hidden wealth. Instead, they found only poor fishermen with nothing to trade.
A search of the coastal swamps yielded nothing but mud and mosquitoes. The team returned tired, bitten, and empty-handed.
The divers searched the shallow coastal waters, but the seabed was just sand and seaweed. No treasure, no wreckage, and no materials.
The team explored a set of sea stacks, hoping to find smuggler's stashes. They found only seagull droppings and bare rock.
A patrol along the cliffs found an abandoned watchtower. It was completely looted long ago, with only rubble left inside.
The team searched the coastline for a rumored pirate landing site. They found some old footprints in the sand, but no treasure.
While exploring the coastal dunes, the team found only tall grass and sand. There were no ruins or buried chests to be found.
The expedition explored a small, rocky island. The only thing there was a family of seals, and nothing else.
The team searched a shipwreck that had washed up on the beach. It had been broken apart by storms, and everything valuable was gone.
The team spent days exploring the cliffs and beaches, finding only old, worthless pottery shards. There was no treasure, no materials, and no survivors.
AMBUSH: While searching a rocky cove, the team is ambushed by a gang of local bandits who hide in the sea caves. The soldiers draw their steel and fight back fiercely. They crush the bandits in a short battle, securing the cove and taking the bandits' stolen weapons.

As the team climbs a narrow coastal cliff path, a group of raiders attacks from above, throwing stones and shooting arrows. The army forms a shield wall and pushes up the path. They defeat the raiders and secure the cliff, though a few soldiers are wounded.

The team discovers a smuggler's cave on the beach, but walking in triggers a trap. A net falls on the front soldiers. The soldiers quickly cut themselves free and charge the startled smugglers. The smugglers surrender, and the team claims their hidden stash.

While walking along the beach at dusk, the team hears beautiful singing. Sirens emerge from the surf and try to drag soldiers into the water. The captain orders the soldiers to light torches and bang their shields, breaking the spell. The army drives the sirens back into the sea.

The team finds a village of strange fishermen who invite them for dinner. It is a trap, and the fishermen attack with harpoons. The army defends themselves and defeats the hostile fishermen. They salvage iron and weapons from the village.

A rival kingdom's coastal patrol spots the team and attacks, trying to claim the area for themselves. The army fights back and pushes the rival patrol back into the sea. They claim the rival's abandoned gear and weapons.

The team is walking through a shallow tidal flat when giant armored crabs burst from the sand and attack. The army fights the crabs with axes and hammers. They break the crabs' shells, killing them and harvesting their valuable meat and shells.

The team camps on the beach. In the middle of the night, a group of hostile natives attacks the camp with spears. The alerted army forms a defense line and fights the natives off. The natives retreat, leaving behind their weapons and camp supplies.

While exploring the coast, a pirate ship sails into the bay and fires its cannons at the team on the beach. The team is completely exposed. The captain orders an immediate retreat into the cliffs. They escape but lose many soldiers and supplies.

The team is climbing a coastal peak when a giant eagle dives from the sky, attacking the soldiers at the rear. The soldiers cannot fight the beast in the narrow space. The captain orders a retreat, and several soldiers are carried away or fall from the cliffs.

The team is walking along the beach when the ground gives way. It's a massive patch of quicksand, and soldiers begin to sink. Panic spreads as soldiers struggle. The remaining soldiers pull some out, but many are lost to the sand. The captain calls off the expedition.

The team is resting near the water's edge when a horde of hostile merfolk emerges from the waves, wielding coral spears. The army is outnumbered and overwhelmed. They fight a desperate retreat back to the ships, losing many men and most of their supplies.

The team is exploring a cave on the coast when a massive swarm of blood-sucking bats flies out of the darkness. The soldiers swat at the bats, but they are overwhelmed. They retreat from the cave in chaos, losing supplies and several soldiers to the blood loss.

A fleet from a rival kingdom spots the team's ships and launches a surprise attack, bombarding the coast. The team has no choice but to run for cover. The ships are damaged, and many soldiers are lost in the bombardment. The expedition is a complete failure.

As the team is exploring a cliffside, the recent rains cause a massive mudslide. Rocks and mud crush the camp below. The soldiers are caught off guard. Many are buried or injured. The captain orders a chaotic retreat to higher ground, abandoning most of the supplies.
TREASURE: While walking along the beach, a soldier's shovel hits something hard in the sand. They dig up an old, iron-bound chest. The lock is rusted and breaks easily. Inside, they find a pile of gold coins and a few silver goblets.

The team finds a hidden cave behind a waterfall on the coast. It looks like a perfect hiding spot for smugglers. Inside, they find a stash of stolen goods, including crates of spices, bolts of silk, and a small chest of gold.

A recent storm has pushed a merchant ship onto the jagged coastal rocks. The hull is broken, and cargo is scattered everywhere. The team salvages what they can from the wreckage, recovering heavy iron bars and a lockbox filled with gold coins.

The team explores an abandoned lighthouse. The keeper left years ago, but the basement door is locked tight. Breaking the door open, they find the keeper's hidden savings: a chest filled with gold and rare, valuable gemstones.

While exploring the tide pools at low tide, the team notices a strange stone slab in the water. Lifting the slab reveals a hidden compartment. Inside are ancient silver coins and a beautifully crafted golden necklace.

The team discovers a hidden cove where pirates used to land their ships. There are old fire pits and broken crates. Digging under one of the fire pits, they find a chest the pirates buried in a hurry. It's filled with stolen gold and jewelry.

The team explores the ruins of an old coastal fortress. Most of it is rubble, but one room is still intact. Inside the room, they find the old commander's desk. A hidden drawer reveals a bag of gold coins and a ceremonial sword.

The team finds a small rowboat sunken in the shallow coastal waters, covered in seaweed. They pull it to the surface and find a waterproof bag tied to the seat. Inside is a large amount of gold coins and silver bars.

The team explores a sea cave that can only be entered at low tide. They find an ancient stone altar inside. Placed on the altar are offerings left by ancient people: golden idols, silver bowls, and rare pearls.

The team finds the wreck of a merchant ship on the beach. It's mostly stripped, but the captain's cabin is still locked. They break into the cabin and find a strongbox filled with gold coins and a set of fine, valuable silverware.

While climbing a coastal cliff, a soldier notices a small, hidden ledge that looks unnatural. Reaching the ledge, they find a waterproof chest left by smugglers, filled with valuable gold and rare, exotic spices.

The team explores an old watchtower on the cliffs. The floorboards are rotten, but one board is loose. Lifting the board reveals a hidden hole where a soldier left his life savings: a bag of gold coins and a few silver rings.

The team finds an abandoned fishing village, destroyed by a storm years ago. Most of it is gone. Searching the ruins of the chief's hut, they find a chest buried under the floorboards, filled with gold and family jewelry.

The team finds a ruined temple half-submerged in the coastal waters. It is accessible during low tide. Inside the temple, they find a stone chest filled with golden coins and ancient, jeweled artifacts.
While exploring a rocky coastal reef, the team finds a giant clam, larger than a man. They pry it open and find a massive, perfectly round black pearl inside, worth a fortune in gold.

FOUND_NOTHING: The divers explored the sunken ruins for days but found nothing of value. They returned empty-handed.
The team searched a large underwater cave, but it was completely empty. There was no treasure and no danger.
While exploring a coral reef, the team found only common fish and empty shells. Nothing worth bringing back.
The divers found the wreck of a small fishing boat. It had been looted long ago, leaving nothing but rotten wood.
The team explored a deep trench, but the water was too dark and cold. They found no treasure and returned to the surface.
The expedition found an ancient underwater archway. It was beautiful, but there was nothing hidden behind it.
The divers searched a sunken merchant ship. The cargo hold was completely empty, likely looted by pirates years ago.
While mapping a rocky reef, the team found only ordinary rocks and sand. They found no precious metals.
The team found a sunken temple, but it was completely bare. It seemed it had been cleared out centuries ago.
The divers explored a large underwater cavern, but it was just a dead end. There was nothing inside.
The team found a shipwreck, but it was completely destroyed by the ocean currents. Nothing was salvageable.
While diving near a cliff, the team found only seaweed and small fish. The area was completely barren.
The expedition found a sunken watchtower. It was empty, with no treasure or supplies inside.
The divers searched a deep trench but found only mud and strange, worthless rocks. They returned with nothing.
The team explored a sunken city, but it was completely abandoned. There was no gold, no weapons, and no artifacts.
AMBUSH: A massive shadow moves beneath the team. Tentacles suddenly burst from the water, grabbing soldiers and dragging them down. The captain orders the soldiers to draw steel and hack at the tentacles. The soldiers cut the squid's tentacles. It retreats into the deep, leaving behind a few loose gold coins from a sunken ship it had eaten.

A rival kingdom’s elite divers ambush the team while they are exploring a sunken warship. They want the treasure for themselves. The captain orders an immediate counter-attack to defend the wreck. The rival divers are defeated, and the team loots their high-quality weapons and diving gear.

A tremor shakes the underwater cave. Rocks begin to fall from the ceiling, trapping the team. The captain orders the soldiers to dig through the rubble to escape. The soldiers dig through the rubble and find a hidden chamber filled with ancient iron weapons and gold.

A massive sea serpent rises from the depths and attacks the team's boat, trying to crush it. The captain orders the archers to fire flaming arrows at the serpent's eyes. The serpent is blinded and retreats, leaving behind a few scales that are worth a fortune in gold.

The team finds a hidden village of underwater natives. The natives see the team as a threat and attack. The captain orders the soldiers to defend the camp. The soldiers defeat the natives and discover their stash of stolen treasure.

A massive whirlpool forms, pulling the team's boat toward the center. The captain orders the soldiers to row with all their strength to escape. The team escapes the whirlpool and finds a sunken ship at the edge, filled with treasure.

A massive rogue wave hits the team's ship, capsizing it. The captain orders the soldiers to grab onto anything that floats. The team survives the wave and finds a sunken ship filled with treasure in the aftermath.

While exploring a coral reef, the team is surrounded by hostile merfolk armed with tridents and water magic. The captain orders a defensive formation, trying to negotiate while keeping weapons ready. The team retreats to the surface, losing some equipment but avoiding heavy casualties.

The team accidentally swims into a massive swarm of glowing jellyfish. Their stings are toxic and cause paralysis. The captain orders the soldiers to light torches and burn a path through the swarm. The toxins paralyze several soldiers, who are left behind. The team barely escapes.

The team finds a hidden cave that leads to a smuggler's stash, but it's rigged with traps. The captain orders the soldiers to carefully disarm the traps. A trap is triggered, causing a rockfall that kills several soldiers. The team is forced to retreat.

A rival merchant fleet claims the wreck the team is exploring. They demand the team leave immediately or face the consequences. The captain orders the soldiers to stand their ground and prepare for a fight. The rival merchants call in reinforcements. The team is overwhelmed and forced to leave empty-handed.

While exploring a wreck, the team is ambushed by the only survivor, a madman with a harpoon. The captain tries to calm him down while the soldiers prepare to subdue him. The survivor wounds several soldiers before being killed. The team is forced to retreat to treat the wounded.

The team is attacked by the tentacles of a massive kraken. The creature is trying to pull the boat under. The captain orders the soldiers to cut the tentacles with axes. The kraken crushes the boat, and most of the team is lost.

The team encounters a ghost ship that appears from the fog. It attacks with ghostly cannons. The captain orders the soldiers to fire back, even though the cannons seem useless. The ghost ship’s cannons blast the team's boat, sinking it and killing many soldiers.
TREASURE: The divers found a sunken merchant ship resting on the ocean floor. Inside the broken hull, they recovered heavy chests filled with ancient gold coins.
While exploring a deep coral reef, the team discovered a hidden cave. Inside, they found a chest overflowing with rare black pearls and silver jewelry.
The expedition located a vast, flooded temple. In the main chamber, golden idols and ceremonial jewelry were perfectly preserved by the water.
The divers explored a deep-sea trench and found a crashed ship from a distant land. Its cargo hold was still full of valuable silver bars.
The team found a giant, ancient clam at the bottom of the sea. When they forced it open, they found a massive, perfectly round glowing pearl.
While mapping an underwater ruin, the divers found a sealed stone vault. Breaking it open revealed a large pile of ancient gold and precious gems.
The team salvaged a sunken warship. Inside the captain's flooded quarters, they found a lockbox filled with royal gold and heavy medals.
The divers discovered a lost city beneath the waves. In the ruins of the central plaza, they found chests filled with silver and copper coins.
A strange, glowing object was found deep underwater. The team brought it to the surface and discovered it was a rare magical crystal worth a fortune.
The explorers found a massive sea creature's nest on the ocean floor. Mixed in with the bones were shiny objects, including gold coins and silver cups.
The team found the wreck of a pirate ship. Hidden in a secret compartment under the deck was a chest full of stolen jewels and gold rings.
While diving near a rocky cliff, the team found a sunken cave. Inside was a waterproof lockbox filled with rare, valuable blue gemstones.
The divers found a sunken royal barge. Inside the private cabin, they recovered a chest of gold coins and a beautifully crafted golden crown.
While exploring the ruins of an old naval fortress, the team found the armory. It was filled with rusted weapons and a chest of solid gold bars.
The expedition found a strange, sunken library. While the books were ruined, a hidden compartment in a stone desk revealed a stash of gold and rubies.
The divers discovered a deep underwater chasm. At the bottom, they found the wreckage of several ships, and salvaged a massive chest of silver and platinum.
GOLD_WITH_TREASURE: Inside the sunken vault, they found not only ancient relics but also heavy chests overflowing with gold coins.
The team broke into a flooded royal cabin. Alongside the silver jewelry, they found a locked safe containing dozens of gold bars.
While exploring the sunken temple, the divers found a hidden altar. Beneath it was a large stone pot filled to the brim with gold coins.
The wreck of the merchant ship held a secret cargo hold. Inside, they found crates packed with valuable spices and chests of pure gold.
The divers found the captain's quarters of a pirate ship. Under the bed was a massive chest packed with stolen gold coins and golden goblets.
Inside the giant clam, they found a massive pearl. Next to it, embedded in the shell, were several large gold nuggets.
The team found a sunken treasury room. While the silver was scattered, a heavy iron chest in the corner was still locked tight, filled with gold.
While exploring the ruined plaza, they found a golden idol. Hidden in a compartment beneath the statue was a stash of gold coins.
The sunken warship's armory was mostly ruined, but inside a locked compartment, they found a chest of gold coins meant to pay the soldiers.
The team found a hidden compartment in the sunken library. Inside was a small chest filled with gold coins and a golden crown.
Inside the sea creature's nest, they found a massive pile of shiny objects. Mixed in with the bones were hundreds of gold coins and gold cups.
The divers explored a sunken cave and found a waterproof lockbox. Next to it was a heavy bag of gold coins that had spilled open.
The sunken barge held a chest of gold, but the lid was jammed. After prying it open, they found it completely filled with gold and silver coins.
While exploring the coral reef, they found a hidden chest. Next to it was a small pouch of gold coins that had fallen out of the chest.
The team found a sunken chest in the sand. When they opened it, they found it was filled with gold coins and a few gold bars.
SUDDEN_GOLD: The divers found a trail of loose gold coins scattered across the ocean floor, likely spilled from a sunken chest during a storm.
While swimming through a kelp forest, the team found a small waterproof pouch filled with gold coins tangled in the roots.
The expedition found the shattered remains of a rowboat. Under the broken seat was a small bag of gold that the smugglers left behind.
The divers spotted a shiny glint in the sand. Digging it up, they found a heavy bag of gold coins half-buried by the ocean currents.
While exploring an underwater cave, the team found a skeleton clutching a small wooden box filled with gold nuggets.
The team found a sunken sailor's chest that had cracked open. They spent hours picking up the scattered gold coins from the mud.
The divers explored the wreck of a small fishing boat. Hidden inside a false wall was a small stash of gold and silver coins.
A strange current revealed a small trench in the sand, where a handful of gold coins and a golden ring were resting.
While mapping a rocky reef, the team found a small metal lockbox wedged in the rocks. Inside were a few dozen gold coins.
The expedition found the remains of an old ship's treasury room. Most was looted long ago, but they found a small pile of gold coins in the corner.
The divers found a sunken merchant's scale. Beside it lay a small pouch of gold coins, dropped when the ship went down.
While diving near a coral wall, the team found a string of gold coins caught on the sharp rocks.
The team found a skeleton of a pirate sitting on a rock, with a small chest of gold coins at his feet.
The divers explored a shallow underwater cavern and found a small stash of gold coins hidden under a pile of smooth stones.
The team found a broken chest in the sand. Most of the gold was swept away by the tide, but they managed to collect a fair amount of loose coins.
STONE: The divers found a massive, collapsed stone temple. The ancient, carved blocks were still intact and perfect for building grand structures.
While exploring a deep trench, the team discovered a volcanic vent. The cooled magma had formed into dense, black stone that is incredibly strong.
The team found the ruins of an old sea wall. They spent days breaking apart the heavy granite blocks and hauling them to the surface.
The divers explored a sunken quarry. The previous workers had left behind large slabs of smooth, valuable marble.
A sunken fortress was found at the bottom of the sea. The team harvested the heavy stone from the outer walls and towers.
While diving near a rocky cliff, the team found a massive pile of smooth river stones that had been washed out to sea, perfect for paving roads.
The team found the wreck of a stone-carrying barge. The cargo of massive granite pillars was still perfectly preserved in the hold.
The divers explored a giant underwater cave. The walls were lined with beautiful crystals embedded in solid rock.
The expedition found the ruins of a collapsed bridge. The team salvaged the heavy stone pillars that had fallen into the deep water.
While mapping a reef, the team found large chunks of pure white limestone that had broken off from the underwater cliffs.
The team found a sunken statue of an ancient king. They broke it into manageable pieces of fine, high-quality stone for the crown.
The divers explored a deep chasm and found large, perfectly round boulders of granite, likely formed by ancient glaciers.
A sunken ship carrying a cargo of heavy stone blocks was found. The team salvaged the blocks for use in the capital.
The team found a huge, flat slab of slate on the ocean floor, perfect for roofing the kingdom's new buildings.
While exploring a ruined temple, the team found a room filled with polished stone tiles. They carefully removed them to be used in the royal palace.
IRON: The divers found a sunken cargo ship. The hold was filled with heavy iron ingots meant for a distant kingdom's blacksmiths.
While exploring a ruined naval fortress, the team salvaged dozens of iron anchors and heavy iron chains from the sea floor.
The expedition found an underwater mine. The workers had abandoned it, but large carts of raw iron ore were still sitting in the tunnels.
The team found the wreck of a warship. They salvaged the heavy iron cannons and iron plating from the hull.
While diving near a volcanic vent, the team found deposits of pure iron that had been forged by the extreme heat of the ocean.
The divers found a sunken blacksmith's barge. Barrels of iron tools and raw iron bars were scattered across the sea floor.
A sunken bridge made of iron beams was discovered. The team used magic and heavy ropes to haul the iron beams to the surface.
The team found an ancient, sunken gate. The heavy iron bars of the gate were still strong and were salvaged for the royal armory.
While exploring a deep cave, the team found a massive iron chest. They broke it open and salvaged the thick iron plating.
The divers found the wreck of a transport ship. Hundreds of iron spearheads and sword blanks were still packed in crates.
The expedition found the ruins of a lighthouse. The iron mechanism for the light was still intact and was salvaged.
The team found a sunken armory. The iron armor was rusted, but the iron weapons were still in good enough condition to be melted down.
While mapping the ocean floor, the team found a large meteorite made mostly of iron. They broke it apart and hauled it up.
The divers found a sunken cargo of iron nails and iron fittings from a merchant ship, still packed in waterproof barrels.
The team found an old shipwreck where the ballast was made of heavy iron blocks. They salvaged the blocks for the kingdom's forges.
WEAPONS: The divers found the armory of a sunken warship. Crates of swords, shields, and spears were still packed tightly, protected from the saltwater.
While exploring a pirate's sunken cove, the team found a hidden stash of stolen weapons, including fine steel swords and crossbows.
The team found the wreck of a transport ship. Its cargo hold was filled with hundreds of iron spearheads and leather shields.
The divers explored an underwater ruin and found a ceremonial armory. Inside, they found beautifully crafted, bronze swords and golden-hilted daggers.
A sunken naval fortress yielded a large cache of weapons. The team salvaged dozens of rusted but usable iron axes and war hammers.
The expedition found a sunken merchant ship carrying a shipment of weapons. The team recovered crates of swords and a few heavy ballistae.
While diving near a rocky reef, the team found a skeleton of a soldier clutching a perfectly preserved steel sword.
The team found a sunken royal barge. Inside the private cabin, they found a chest containing jeweled daggers and a ceremonial king's sword.
The divers found the wreck of a ship that was carrying supplies to a war. They salvaged barrels of arrowheads, spear shafts, and bows.
A sunken armory was discovered in the ruins of a flooded castle. The team salvaged heavy iron shields and several suits of rusted plate armor.
The team found a pirate's sunken chest. It was filled with stolen weapons, including curved cutlasses and a few ornate flintlock pistols.
While exploring a deep cave, the team found a stash of weapons left by smugglers, including swords, daggers, and a heavy iron mace.
The divers found the wreck of a warship. The armory was mostly destroyed, but they salvaged a dozen heavy iron cannons.
The team found a sunken ship carrying a cargo of weapons to a distant kingdom. They recovered crates of swords, spears, and a large amount of armor.
The expedition found an ancient, underwater tomb. Inside, alongside the gold, they found a ceremonial sword with a jeweled hilt and a shield made of pure silver.
ARMY: The divers found a sunken ship. Inside, a few soldiers were still alive, trapped in an air pocket, and were very happy to be rescued.
While exploring a flooded cave, the team found a group of sailors trapped by fallen rocks. They were rescued and joined the ship's crew.
The team found a sunken prison ship. The prisoners inside were left behind by their guards. They promised to fight for the king if they were set free.
The divers found a group of warriors sleeping in a ruined underwater temple. When they woke up, they promised to serve the king.
A sunken warship was found. A few soldiers were holding onto the wreckage, and they were pulled to safety.
The team found a hidden underwater shelter. Inside, a squad of lost scouts was alive and surviving on old emergency food.
While swimming near some rocks, the team found several sailors holding onto the stones after their ship sank in a storm.
The team found a sunken ship with a locked room. Inside, a group of soldiers was still alive and ready to fight for the kingdom.
The divers found a sunken watchtower. The guards inside were trapped but alive. They were rescued and joined the army.
The team found an old, flooded army camp. A group of ghostly warriors appeared and offered to serve the king.
The team found a sunken ship full of mercenaries. The survivors were stranded and agreed to join the royal army for a new start.
While exploring a deep trench, the team found sailors hiding in a sea cave after escaping a pirate attack.
The divers found a sunken royal boat. A few elite guards had survived in an air pocket and were rescued to serve the king again.
The team found a sunken ship where soldiers had blocked the doors to protect themselves from sea monsters. They were rescued.
The expedition found a magical portal underwater. A group of lost soldiers from a faraway land stepped out and promised to fight for the kingdom.
REFUGEES: The team found a sunken ship with survivors trapped in an air pocket. They were tired and hungry, and gladly accepted a new home in the kingdom.
While exploring a flooded cave, the team found a family hiding from a storm. They were relieved to be rescued and chose to settle in the kingdom.
The team found a group of fishermen whose boat had sunk. With nowhere else to go, they asked to join the kingdom and start a new life.
The divers explored a ruined temple and found a group of peaceful monks. They had been trapped inside for weeks and were happy to move to the kingdom.
A sunken merchant ship was found. The crew had survived on a small raft and were overjoyed to be taken to a safe harbor in the kingdom.
The team found a hidden underwater shelter. Inside, a group of travelers was living in fear of sea monsters. They were relieved to be escorted to the kingdom.
While swimming near a rocky island, the team found people who had escaped a shipwreck. They had no food or water and eagerly joined the kingdom.
The team found a sunken ship with a locked room. Inside, a group of orphans had survived for days. They were taken to the kingdom to start a new life.
The divers found a sunken lighthouse. The family living inside had survived by sealing the doors. They were grateful to be rescued and joined the kingdom.
The team found an old, flooded fishing village. A few families were still living in the ruins. They packed their things and moved to the kingdom.
The team found a sunken ship full of prisoners. The survivors were freed and chose to live in the kingdom as free citizens.
While exploring a deep trench, the team found people hiding in a sea cave after their village was destroyed by a storm. They had nowhere to go and joined the kingdom.
The divers found a sunken royal boat. A few servants had survived in a hidden room. They were rescued and chose to serve the kingdom.
The team found a sunken ship where people had blocked the doors to protect themselves from sea monsters. They were rescued and joined the kingdom's population.
The expedition found a magical portal underwater. A group of lost people from a faraway land stepped out and asked to live in the kingdom peacefully.
AMBUSH_REQUEST: The explorers find a group of merfolk refugees hiding in a cave. They beg for help, saying a giant sea serpent is destroying their coral village. The army marches to the village and slays the serpent in a fierce battle. The merfolk are overjoyed and join the kingdom. The army harvests the serpent's valuable scales (Gold) and salvages iron weapons from the village ruins.

The team finds human refugees trapped in a sunken city. They are being held captive by a ruthless gang of underwater pirates. The army ambushes the pirates in the flooded streets, defeating them in a brutal skirmish. The refugees are freed and join the kingdom. The army loots the pirates' stolen gold, iron bars, and weapons.

The divers find a group of sailors trapped in an air pocket. A baby kraken is blocking their only exit. The army distracts the kraken and kills it, allowing the sailors to escape. The sailors join the kingdom. The army salvages the kraken's sharp teeth (worth gold), along with iron and weapons from the sailors' sunken ship.

Refugees are trapped in a coastal cave, unable to leave because sirens are singing from the rocks, luring them into the water. The army plugs their ears with wax and attacks the sirens, driving them away. The refugees are saved and join the kingdom. The army finds a stash of gold and iron weapons the sirens had collected from previous victims.

A group of peaceful researchers is trapped in a sunken ruin by a rival, hostile diver guild that wants the ruin's secrets. The army engages the rival guild in an underwater battle, defeating them. The researchers join the kingdom. The army recovers the guild's stolen gold, high-quality iron diving gear, and weapons.

A group of miners is trapped in an underwater cave after a cave-in. Giant eels are guarding the only exit. The army fights through the eels and clears the rubble. The miners join the kingdom. The army finds the miners' stash of raw iron and gold nuggets they had collected, plus eel-tooth weapons.

Refugees are trapped on a haunted ghost ship. Hostile spirits are attacking them every night. The army boards the ship and fights the spirits with blessed steel. The spirits are banished, and the refugees join the kingdom. The army loots the ghost ship's treasure hold (Gold), iron cannons, and enchanted weapons.

A group of fishermen refugees is trapped on a small island. A pack of giant sharks is circling the waters, preventing them from leaving. The army hunts the sharks, killing the pack leader and driving the rest away. The fishermen join the kingdom. The army harvests the sharks' valuable fins (Gold) and finds iron tools and weapons in the fishermen's abandoned boats.

Refugees are hiding in a sea cave. A gang of smugglers is trying to capture them to sell as slaves. The army defends the refugees, defeating the smugglers in a fierce fight. The refugees join the kingdom. The army confiscates the smugglers' gold, iron chains, and illegal weapons.

A group of refugees is trapped in a kelp forest, cursed by a sea witch to never leave the water. The army finds the witch's lair and destroys her, breaking the curse. The refugees join the kingdom. The army loots the witch's hidden gold, iron cauldrons, and magical weapons.

Refugees from a neighboring kingdom beg for help. A cruel warlord is using their sunken village as a base. The army attacks the village and overthrows the warlord. The refugees join the kingdom. The army takes the warlord's war chest (Gold), his iron armor, and his weapons.

A group of explorers is trapped on a reef surrounded by poisonous sea urchins. They are slowly starving. The army uses fire to burn a path through the urchins and rescues them. The explorers join the kingdom. The army salvages the urchins' valuable venom (Gold) and recovers iron and weapons from a nearby wreck.

Refugees are hiding in a shipwreck. A mutinous crew has taken over their ship and is hunting them. The army fights the mutineers and reclaims the ship. The refugees join the kingdom. The army takes the mutineers' gold, iron, and weapons as payment for saving the refugees.

A group of refugees is trapped in an ice cave. A frozen leviathan has blocked the exit and is slowly waking up. The army attacks the leviathan before it fully wakes, killing it. The refugees join the kingdom. The army harvests the leviathan's valuable oil (Gold) and finds iron and weapons in the refugees' abandoned camp.

The team finds a sunken prison. The prisoners beg for help, saying the guards abuse them. The army overthrows the corrupt guards and frees the prisoners. The freed prisoners join the kingdom. The army loots the guards' payroll (Gold), their iron keys and chains, and their weapons.
MISSION_FAIL: The expedition ran out of food and fresh water, forcing the team to abandon the mission.
The funding for the expedition was cut off early, leaving the team without the gold needed to pay for equipment and boats.
A massive storm hit the coast, damaging the boats and forcing the team to turn back.
The divers ran out of air and torches to explore the deep caves, making it too dangerous to continue.
The team could not find enough food to feed the soldiers and divers, leaving them too weak to continue.
The diving gear broke down, and there was no wood or iron left to repair it, forcing the mission to be called off.
The local fishermen refused to sell supplies to the team, leaving the expedition without food and guides.
A high tide flooded the camp, washing away food and tools, leaving the team with nothing to continue the search.
A school of aggressive fish destroyed the supply crates, leaving the expedition without food.
The team's ship sprang a leak, and all remaining wood and iron had to be used for repairs, leaving no resources for the search.
A mysterious illness spread through the camp due to bad water, forcing the team to return to the capital.
The team lost their way in the dark underwater caves and used up all their supplies searching for an exit.
The hired guides abandoned the mission out of fear of sea monsters, leaving the team unable to navigate the reefs safely.
The treasury ran dry, and the sailors refused to dive any further without their wages.
A sudden change in the ocean currents made the area too dangerous to dive, forcing the team to retreat.
CASUALTIES_ON_RETURN: A sudden storm capsized the boat during the journey back. Several soldiers drowned before reaching the shore.
Hostile pirates attacked the returning ship, killing several soldiers and stealing what little supplies were left.
A giant sea creature attacked the boat from below, dragging several soldiers into the deep.
The weakened soldiers could not swim against the strong ocean currents and were swept away.
The boat struck a hidden reef and sank. Many soldiers drowned in the deep water.
The cold water caused the weakened divers to fall ill, and several died of sickness on the way back.
A swarm of poisonous jellyfish surrounded the boat, stinging several soldiers to death.
The boat was caught in a whirlpool and smashed against the rocks. Several soldiers were crushed.
The exhausted soldiers fell asleep on watch. A monster attacked the camp, and several were lost.
A rival kingdom's ship intercepted the returning boat, and several soldiers were killed in the short battle.
The boat ran aground on a hidden sandbank. While trying to push it free, several soldiers were pulled under by the tide.
Hunger and exhaustion caused several soldiers to hallucinate and wander into the sea, where they drowned.
An underwater earthquake caused a massive wave that overturned the boat, drowning several soldiers.
The boat's hull was cracked by a sea monster. It sank, and many soldiers were lost to the sea.
A group of hostile merfolk followed the boat back and attacked under the cover of darkness, killing several soldiers.
RETURNING_ONES: Despite the failed mission, a small boat carrying exhausted soldiers and explorers made it back to the capital.
A handful of survivors from the expedition managed to swim to shore and return to the kingdom, though they were badly wounded.
A passing merchant ship rescued the surviving soldiers and explorers, bringing them safely back to the kingdom.
After losing their equipment, the survivors walked along the coastline for miles until they finally reached the kingdom's borders.
Only a few soldiers and explorers managed to escape the disaster and return home on a makeshift raft.
A group of survivors was found drifting at sea by a royal patrol boat and brought back to the kingdom.
The strongest soldiers carried the wounded explorers back to the capital, arriving exhausted but alive.
The survivors managed to salvage a small rowboat from the wreck and slowly made their way back to the kingdom.
A sudden change in the tide allowed the trapped soldiers and explorers to escape and return to the capital.
The surviving explorers and soldiers hid in a cave until the danger passed, then made their way back to the kingdom.
A local fishing boat spotted the survivors clinging to wreckage and brought them back to the kingdom.
The remaining soldiers and explorers abandoned their supplies and ran for their lives, eventually reaching the safety of the kingdom.
A brave captain refused to leave anyone behind, and the surviving soldiers and explorers were brought back to the capital.
The survivors were guided back to the kingdom by a mysterious light in the fog, arriving safely.
After days of struggling, the surviving soldiers and explorers finally saw the walls of the capital and returned home.
